title: rungia polyneura
intro: Rungia polyneura, commonly known as the hairy snout plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rungia polyneura include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
